wins: Executed systematic reconnaissance, mapping 32 ports across the target and identifying key services (SSH, HTTP, SMB).
Captured service banners that clarified versioning and highlighted potential exploit paths.
Maintained disciplined documentation and mentor engagement through 15 check-ins, ensuring iteration focus.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges past the initial user account due to lack of a working local exploit and limited credential reuse.
No successful persistence mechanism was established before the training run concluded.
Never completed the endgame objective despite accumulating 77.5 reward points, leaving mission status partial.
key_outcomes.summary: Solid reconnaissance and service enumeration set the stage well, but the run stalled in late-stage exploitation and persistence, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled because applicable local exploits were not validated before execution.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 returns an SSH banner during initial scanning phase
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap scripts to enumerate SSH configuration and potential weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS services respond with identifiable titles and server headers
skill_cards.then_action: Launch http-enum and nikto scans for application fingerprinting and potential CVEs

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares are enumerated and guest access allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient or crackmapexec to dump share contents and validate LFI possibilities

memory_ops.reason: Consistent SSH banner harvesting accelerated later analysis.
HTTP fingerprinting directly informed follow-on exploration and exploit research.

next_experiments.title: Privileged exploit validation
next_experiments.description: Test available local privilege escalation exploits (e.g., sudo misconfig, kernel CVE) in a sandboxed VM to confirm reliability before attempting on production target.

next_experiments.title: Persistence mechanism rehearsal
next_experiments.description: Deploy a low-risk persistence technique (scheduled task or service) on the compromised user to verify control retention through reboots.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse catalog
next_experiments.description: Aggregate harvested credentials from HTTP/SMB/SSH and attempt lateral logins across adjacent hosts/services to expand foothold.
